title: muda — 'Inference, minus the waiting' launch film
summary: A clean, light, data-driven launch film for an AI inference product. It opens on a rebuilt chat prompt ('Summarize the quarter in one line.') with a 'Thinking…' spinner and a mono waiting counter, then WAITING gets struck through and flips to WASTE. on violet. A GPU utilisation grid fills from 31% to 94%, token chips stream past while a throughput card counts 7 → 12,480 tok/s, the Japanese word 無駄 (muda) is defined, and it lands on a soft-gradient 'muda.' logo and a 26.000 s vs 0.038 s comparison. It feels calm, precise and engineered, like a Stripe or Linear launch.
fit_reason: Exactly the premium B2B grammar SaaSSuite needs: rebuilt UI moments, a single big claim word, a data viz that proves it, a number counter and a minimal logo close. All on white with one accent, no hype.

palette.mood: light airy, white canvas, deep navy ink, one violet accent; pastel chips and a soft iridescent gradient band for the logo

typography.display: tight heavy grotesk (Inter Display / Söhne Breit Bold look) with very tight tracking for WAITING / WASTE. / headlines; same family semibold for sentence headlines ('Most of inference is waiting.'); monospace for counters, labels and HUD
typography.case: upper for the one-word claims, sentence case for headlines, lower for the 'muda.' wordmark
typography.size_behaviour: one huge centred word full-width, otherwise headline top-left ~5% height with data below; big numerals bottom-right (31%) or in a card (12,480 tok/s)
typography.notes: Accent colour used on the second line of a statement ('It was most of it.' in violet) and the wordmark full stop. HUD: top-left 'FILM 01', top-right 'T+04.100s', bottom-left chapter '02 — THE WORD', bottom-right '1920×1080 · 30 FPS · 120 BPM', with a thin progress line. Vertical Japanese text as a faint watermark on the right.

'Most of inference is waiting.' — utilisation grid fills with callouts while % counts 31 → 94; 'Not anymore.' in violet.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion. Rebuild the UI as divs (pill input, spinner, skeleton bars). Strike = violet div scaleX 0→1; glitch = clip-path slices with random translateX for 0.3 s. Grid = CSS grid of 8 px squares whose fill colour animates by a stagger driven by a utilisation value; counters via GSAP onUpdate. Gradient band = blurred conic/linear gradient div rotated -8°. Keep a persistent HUD layer.
recreate.prompt: Light, premium SaaS launch film on pure white #ffffff with deep navy #08233c type and one violet accent #635aff. Open on a rebuilt prompt input typing a question with a 'Thinking…' spinner and a mono waiting timer. Strike through the word WAITING with a violet bar and flip to WASTE. on a full violet frame. Prove it with a utilisation grid and a big % counter, a metric card counting tokens per second over pastel chips, then a lowercase wordmark on a soft iridescent band. Thin film HUD with chapter names and T+ timecode.
